Description:
Ballistics of the 3VOF42 round, with the 3OF43 "Albatross" HE-Frag shell and the 4-Z-3 reduced-variable charge, fired from the 203mm 2A44 as part of the 2S7 "Pion" and the 2S7M "Malka" self-propelled gun. This entry represent the 4-Z-3 charge at zone 3. Loads 11.8 kg of 15/7 pyroxylin grains.

From manual, rifling length is 9550 mm, length of chamber (breech to start of rifling) is 1504 mm, chamber is 63 L. The tables from АРТИЛЛЕРИЙСКИЕ МЕТАТЕЛЬНЫЕ ЗАРЯДЫ indicate:
T   mv  Pmcp
°C  m/s MPa
-50 490 61.78
15  500 92.17

Pressure given is interpreted as copper crusher gauge pressure, 1.12x correction applied to convert to piezoelectric values.
